title: Waist
abstract: Formalization of waist inequalities for different settings: (1) Gromov's waist theorem for the round sphere S^n (the original proof in Memarian arXiv:0911.3972 has gaps; here a spherical adaptation of Klartag's proof is used); (2) An explicit positive lower bound on the unnormalized (n-k)-dimensional Hausdorff measure (Mathlib's muH[n-k], defined via sum of (diam U_i)^{n-k} without the unit-ball normalization factor omega_{n-k} / 2^{n-k}, in the chordal metric on S^n) of a fiber on the round sphere S^n: muH[n-k](f^{-1}(y)) >= 1 / (12 * 4^n * 3^k), yielding the positive lower bound (omega_{n-k} / 2^{n-k}) / (12 * 4^n * 3^k) for conventionally normalized Hausdorff measure (motivated by Gromov's 2003 conjecture of the sharp bound vol(S^{n-k}), which remains open for 1 < k < n; proved via Akopyan modification of Klartag's argument, Waists.sphere_hausdorff_waist); (3) The Gaussian waist inequality on (R^n, gamma_n) (Gromov 2003, Klartag arXiv:1608.04121); (4) The waist of the open unit cube (0,1)^n (Klartag arXiv:1608.04121); (5) The waist of the Euclidean ball B^n(R) with arbitrary center and radius (Akopyan-Karasev, arXiv:1608.06279); (6) The waist of a spherical ball of radius R < pi in S^n (Akopyan-Karasev, arXiv:1702.07513); (7) The waist of a hyperbolic ball of radius R in H^n (Akopyan-Karasev, arXiv:1702.07513); (8) The waist of an ellipsoid with semi-axes a_1 <= ... <= a_n (Akopyan-Karasev, arXiv:1608.06279, Corollary 1); (9) The waist of a box / parallelotope (0, a_1) x ... x (0, a_n) (Akopyan-Karasev, arXiv:1608.06279, Corollary 2). Supporting developments include: classical and tree Borsuk-Ulam theorems derived from combinatorial Tucker-type lemmas; Prékopa-Leindler and Brunn-Minkowski inequalities; spherical cap quasiconcavity; Archimedes' projection; and Frostman center measures.
